hypothesis: When repeated genuinely causal associations and unique distracting facts are independently interleaved within each world, a clockless learned actual-outcome write gate retains useful mappings and outperforms strong fully trained conventional action-history and exact-key classical factual controls under heldout distracting overlap.

source.action: independently executed randomized +/-1 for each observed key
source.query: single independently executed query action/outcome at one randomly chosen target key AFTER all facts; query target not revealed to write gates
source.interleaving: per-world uniformly randomized permutation of 32 repeated-target and 32 unique distractor events; all keys, actions and observed deltas permuted together
source.unfamiliar_shift: OOD distractor keys project 2x onto target subspace before normalization, versus unmodified normalized FIT/VAL distractor keys

arms.candidate: 3 scalar learned gate using original 16x16 TTT update with current factual before-write norm and observed residual cosine, NO timestep or phase feature
arms.wrong_credit: same capacity/architecture and training, independently redrawn incorrect executed action labels on historical facts, true executed query action and observed reward intact
arms.GRU: fully trained conventional GRU 33-dimensional factual events and 16d physical query readout; hidden width 32, train once per initialization on identical factual episodes and factual-only final reward
arms.strong_classical: 256-float original all-write, learned FIT-only threshold surprise and prior read norm, 8-slot key/value FIFO 256-float, and unlimited-capacity all-history exact-context factual nearest neighbor (explicitly OVER_BUDGET baseline, not matched-state eligible for formal strong-capacity gate)
arms.random: same 256-float matrix and learned FIT write acceptance rate, random gate, per-init fixed random seed
arms.oracle: source-privileged hidden label skip of distractors; NOT fair benchmark or deployment claim

frozen_gates_all_seeds.candidate_mse_le_unlimited_exact_key_x_0: diagnostic only: not equal capacity; do not treat as formal capacity-matched science

negative_controls: No time/phase feature in learned gate; all 64 events randomized and actual query key unknown until completed history
Quantify same-key repetitions and chance query lookahead
Wrong-credit actual-action labels are independently redrawn, never invertible by fixed rolling
Same query physical observation and action for ALL comparable arms
Retain 1,024-float+ all-history KNN as explicitly unfair memory but conventional shortcut check
Exact 8-slot FIFO memory capacity 256 floats; no hidden phase oracle
Run 6 no-source tests against exact code and immutable source/split hashes
